property_summary: For any admissible timestamp t strictly greater than the stored pastBlockTime, a call sending exactly 10 ether must succeed and record pastBlockTime == t; the mutant overwrites pastBlockTime before its own checks, making the monotonicity require always fail, so every such call reverts.
change_summary: Move the statement `pastBlockTime = block.timestamp;` to the top of the function so it updates even when the requires revert-path checks fail afterwards.
